neighbours.label: the words neighbor(s), Uncle and Aunt: people close to the family but outside the household
fire: The fence between our garden and the neighbor's yard blew down in the storm.
Every Christmas Uncle Frank carved the turkey and told the same jokes.
A postcard from Aunt Louise arrived on Tuesday morning.
For years the neighbors complained about the barking dog.
My mother's sister, Aunt Rose, taught me how to knit.
The boy ran next door to ask the neighbor for help.
On Sundays we drove out to visit my uncle at the lake.
Two of the neighbors kept an eye on the house while we were away.
quiet: The wall between our garden and the school playground fell in the gale.
Each Easter my father roasted a lamb and sang the same songs.
A parcel from Doctor Grant came on Thursday afternoon.
For years the tenants complained about the broken lift.
My older sister, Rose, taught me how to knit.
The boy ran to the station to ask the policeman for help.
On Saturdays we cycled out to see my friend by the river.
Two of the teachers kept an eye on the hall during the exam.

notes: Card: ' neighbor', ' neighbors', ' Uncle', ' Aunt', also Korean and Russian words for neighbour and uncle. Probing: neighbor 0.67, Uncle 0.62, Aunt 0.78, neighbors 0.37; brother 0.06, colleague 0.08, cousin 0.17, 'Grandpa Peter' 0.28.
